start: Exercise library, no exercise called 'Cable Y Raise'

steps.action: Start a new exercise from the library
user_sees: Rows 'How you log it', 'Main muscle', 'Equipment', 'Also works', 'Weight goes up by'
must_not: Save reachable while the name or main muscle is missing

steps.action: Type the name, pick main muscle and equipment, add a photo from the gallery
user_sees: The photo shown in the card
must_not: The picked photo lost when the sheet closes

user_sees: It is in every exercise list straight away
must_not: The exercise missing from the list until a restart

start: A live workout, Add exercise, the search finds nothing

steps.action: Make a new exercise from the workout's add list
user_sees: Screen 'New exercise' with the button 'Save and add to workout'

steps.action: Fill it in and tap 'Save and add to workout'
user_sees: Back on the workout with the new exercise added
must_not: The exercise saved but not added, with no word

start: A library exercise's page (one from the exercise library)

steps.action: Open its menu and choose 'Your photo or video'
user_sees: '<name> comes from the exercise library. You can add your own photo or video of it here.'
must_not: The library name, muscles or type editable

steps.action: Take a short video and save
user_sees: The video on the exercise page
must_not: The library exercise's name or muscles changed

steps.action: Type the name of an exercise that already exists (other case or spaces) and save
user_sees: Question 'Already in your library' with '"<name>" already exists.' and 'Open it'
must_not: A second exercise with the same name

steps.action: Pick a video longer than the limit
user_sees: 'Could not add it' with 'Pick a video of <n> seconds or less — one or two reps is plenty.'

steps.action: Refuse the camera and choose 'Take a photo'
user_sees: 'MettleUp needs the camera for this. You can allow it in your phone settings, or choose from your gallery.'
must_not: A crash or an empty screen

start: An own exercise with logged sets

user_sees: 'This exercise already has logged sets, so how it is logged stays the same.'
must_not: 'How you log it' changeable once sets are logged

user_sees: The new name on its page, in History and in routines
must_not: Old workouts showing the old name

user_sees: The exercise page without a photo
